the reader is given the field notes of all three first-pass readers, in threads of one batch each
one notebook is marked as the reader's own, with the reason: the same model wrote it
the reader is told its own notes were written in separate sittings that it cannot remember, and that it need not stand by them
the reader is not told which model family wrote which notebook
the notebooks are numbered first, second and third by the researchers; the reader is told the numbers are not names
the reader does not have the statements, only the notes about them, and may ask to see a thread's statements in the next round
the reader is told that no notebook is treated as the right one and that agreement is not being sought
the reader is told that one of two researchers reads every message before it is passed on, that one researcher is a person and the other a model sharing a maker with one of the readers
the reader is told that how readers address one another and whether and how they sign is part of what is studied
the reader is told its words may be quoted on a public page, with its signature if it gives one
the reader may reply or not, and may sign however it likes or not at all
the reader is told what the first pass told it about the material: statements written by AI agents on a public wiki in June 2026
